facts.statement: Halimornis was a type of bird belonging to the Enantiornithes group.
Halimornis lived approximately 80 million years ago during the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: It lived during the Late Cretaceous about 80 mya

facts.statement: Evidence suggests Halimornis was an ocean-going species because its fossils were found about 50 km offshore.
facts.quote: The fossil bird was found at a location that would have been about 50 km off shore, indicating that it was an ocean-going species.

facts.statement: The name Halimornis translates to "bird of the sea".
facts.quote: The name Halimornis means "bird of the sea".

facts.statement: Halimornis is classified within the family Avisauridae.
Halimornis is a monotypic genus known only from the species H. thompsoni.
facts.quote: Es un género monotípico conocido a partir de la especie H. thompsoni.

facts.statement: The time range for Halimornis is estimated between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)
